General
F5 is a global leader in delivering and securing every application and Application Programming Interface ("API"). Today, these business-critical workloads span a highly complex and distributed mix of on-premises data centers, private and public clouds, SaaS platforms, and edge environments. Artificial intelligence ("AI") is accelerating this complexity and fundamentally changing how applications are built and deployed while expanding both the attack surface and the velocity of threats. Through the F5 Application Delivery and Security Platform ("ADSP"), which unites our BIG-IP, NGINX, and Distributed Cloud product portfolios, F5 converges application delivery and security to keep applications and APIs fast, available, and secure wherever they run. By converging these capabilities in a single platform, F5 enables organizations to accelerate time-to-market, reduce operational complexity, and enforce zero-trust application security across traditional, modern, containerized, and AI-driven workloads. Backed by more than 30 years of mission-critical expertise, F5 provides the trusted foundation to deliver fast, available, and secure digital experiences.
Our application delivery and security solutions are available in a range of deployment and consumption models. We sell packaged software in perpetual, subscription, and usage-based consumption models. We also sell our solutions in software-as-a-service ("SaaS") and managed services deployment models with subscription and usage-based consumption models. In addition, we sell high-performance systems, or hardware, as well as a broad range of global services including maintenance, consulting, training, and other technical support services.

Cyber Incident
On October 15, 2025, we disclosed a security incident in which a threat actor maintained long-term, persistent access to F5 systems, and exfiltrated a limited number of certain files, referred to as the "Cyber Incident." For further information about the Cyber Incident, see "Risk Factors" included in Item 1A of Part I of this Annual Report on Form 10-K, and "Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations - Cyber Incident" included in Item 7 of Part II of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.
Strategy and Priorities
F5's strategy is built around a single, consistent requirement: applications and APIs must be fast, available, and secure everywhere they run. Enterprise infrastructure has become more distributed, spanning data centers, private clouds, public clouds, SaaS platforms, and edge environments. This evolution has come not by design, but through years of cloud migration, application modernization, and evolving business needs. AI is accelerating that complexity, introducing new traffic patterns, infrastructure requirements, and security risks as organizations move AI workloads into production. At the same time, attackers are moving faster, automating more, and increasingly targeting the applications, APIs, and AI systems that businesses depend on.
F5 addresses these challenges through the F5 ADSP, under which we are uniting our BIG-IP, NGINX, and Distributed Cloud portfolios to deliver unified policy, consistent management, and integrated services. Key components of our strategy include:
Converging application delivery and security. Performance, availability, and security can no longer be treated as separate priorities. F5 embeds traffic management, threat mitigation, and access control across our software, SaaS, and hardware offerings. F5's solutions enable organizations to enforce consistent policies, eliminate redundant point products, and reduce operational complexity across distributed IT environments.
Reducing complexity across hybrid multicloud. Most organizations manage applications and APIs across a fragmented mix of environments, each with its own tools, policies, and operations overhead. F5 provides a single operational framework, including unified policy enforcement, consistent management, and assured digital sovereignty, so organizations can deliver and secure applications across hybrid multicloud environments without adding complexity.
Building for the AI era. AI is moving from experimentation to production, creating new demands on infrastructure. AI factories require purpose-built traffic management. AI agents and automated workflows require reliable, low-latency access to APIs, models, and data. AI data flows require the right data in the right place at the right time. AI-enabled applications still require the same performance, availability, and security as mission-critical systems. F5 delivers the application delivery and security capabilities organizations need as AI workloads scale, without compromising reliability or control.
Protecting against an expanding and evolving threat landscape. Attackers are automating exploitation, targeting APIs and AI agents, and accelerating vulnerability discovery. The attack surface now extends across applications, APIs, bots, user interactions, AI agents, and the model endpoints and data pipelines they depend on. F5 delivers purpose-built protection, including bot-defense, API security, AI agent security, DDoS mitigation, and runtime enforcement, where traffic and interactions occur. For AI-specific risks, F5 provides AI guardrails to enforce policy and prevent misuse across AI-enabled interactions, and red-team testing capabilities to identify vulnerabilities in AI systems before they can be exploited.

F5 Products and Solutions
F5 delivers and secures applications and APIs across hybrid multicloud environments. Our solutions are powered by three core product families: F5 BIG-IP, F5 NGINX, and F5 Distributed Cloud. We are converging these offerings under the F5 ADSP, an evolving architectural framework designed to unify traffic management, advanced security, and automated operations. F5 ADSP supports a comprehensive set of customer use cases, including delivering and securing traditional and modern containerized applications, protecting and governing APIs, defending against web exploits and DDoS attacks, enforcing Zero Trust access, and optimizing and securing AI inference and data pipelines. By bringing these capabilities together under a unified platform, we enable organizations to enforce consistent policy, reduce operational complexity, and protect digital experiences across any environment.
Security Solutions. Our security solutions safeguard applications, APIs, and network infrastructure against the expanding threat landscape including automated exploitation, bot attacks, API abuse, AI agent threats, unauthorized access, and volumetric attacks. As AI moves into production, F5's security capabilities extend to protect AI-enabled applications, AI agents, and the model endpoints and data pipelines they depend on. F5 security solutions are available across data centers, public clouds, edge environments, and AI architectures. F5 security solutions include:
• Application Security
• F5 WAF for BIG-IP. Provides web application protection through behavioral analytics, bot defense, and application-layer encryption. This product can be leveraged through software, public cloud, or hardware and can be purchased as part of a bundle or on a standalone basis. The offering is available on F5 BIG-IP deployments as a perpetual license or a software subscription.
• F5 WAF for Distributed Cloud. Provides web application firewall capabilities through a cloud-native platform with a common policy engine and management console. This solution can be leveraged through multiple deployment options, including F5's global points of presence, public or private clouds, and on-premises. The offering is available as a SaaS subscription.
